_source.title: 外部库元素
_source.remarks.text.0: 此处需要传递 `url` 或 `data` 字段，如若同时传入，则取 `data` 的数据，忽略 `url` 字段
_source.remarks.text.1: 如若仅传入 `url` 字段，将会对其发起请求并尝试获取其库文件
_source.remarks.text.2: `data` 的数据可为 Blob 格式或 DataURL 格式

title: External library item
remarks.text.0: Here the `url` or `data` field needs to be passed. If both are passed, the data of `data` is used and the `url` field is ignored
remarks.text.1: If only the `url` field is passed in, a request will be made to it to try to obtain its library file
remarks.text.2: The data of `data` can be in Blob or DataURL format
